accepted_risks.risk: Client-side state does not hold authoritative PHI
accepted_risks.justification: All clinical state is authoritatively checked and signed by Django backend and Neon PostgreSQL. Frontend is untrusted display layer.

false_positives.reason: Healthcheck endpoint produces purely application/json without HTML rendering surface.
